Each postcard names a location or shows its flag. Fly there and land on it to deliver the postcard.

Fly up to see more of the world and fly faster. Let go to glide down.

Flying up uses energy. Each delivery replenishes some energy.

Three incorrect landings in a row will reveal the destination.

The closer you land, the more points.

Land before the timer's halfway mark for full speed points.
